title: Teammate V1 × v2.12 Fusion A/B
subtitle: A read-only architecture walkthrough backed by frozen Public200 and local 2k OOF evidence.

public200.label: Public200
public200.semantics: Organizer-released 200-session development set; exact-repeat local evaluation.

two_k_oof.label: 2k OOF
two_k_oof.semantics: Local train_explore 2,000-session out-of-fold benchmark; this is not the organizer private score.
two_k_oof.risk: B is not zero-harm: fold 0 HR changes from 1.0000 to 0.9975, fold 0 MRR regresses, and intent-override loses two hits.

t0.label: Teammate T0
t0.tagline: High-recall lexical retrieval with a stateful multi-signal scorer
t0.question_policy: Specific catalog-answerable attributes only; no other.

layers.name: Visible input
layers.detail: user_profile, user message, turn and top_k only.

layers.name: Session parser
layers.detail: Accumulates intent, category, constraints, replies and override state.

layers.name: FTS1000 + category
layers.detail: Field-weighted FTS5 lexical candidates plus the category pool.

layers.name: ProductScorer
layers.detail: Lexical, category, constraint, department, budget, rating and popularity signals.

layers.name: Exact-category guard
layers.detail: Repairs a known malformed-category boundary without global demotion rules.

layers.name: Unseen ledger
layers.detail: Removes already shown products and emits the next ordered Top10.

layers.name: Specific question
layers.detail: Chooses an answerable attribute from the current Top100 candidate distribution.

a.label: Fusion A
a.tagline: Two-page T0 exploitation, then v2.12 unseen exploration
a.question_policy: Keeps T0 specific questions and rejects ask_attribute=other.
a.decision: Strict fusion base; not better than T0 on Public200

layers.name: Dual state reset
layers.detail: Starts both T0 and the v2.12 rank expert with the same visible session input.

layers.name: T0 forward pass
layers.detail: Always computes the teammate response, ProductScorer order and specific question.

layers.name: v2.12 rank shadow
layers.detail: Computes R08/P11 plus the frozen fold-safe small-ranker order without serving its question.

layers.name: Two-page grace
layers.detail: Intent pages 1–2 return T0 exactly and populate the served ledger.

layers.name: Unseen expert tail
layers.detail: Page 3+ selects unseen rank-expert candidates, then fills from unseen T0 order.

layers.name: Fail-safe fallback
layers.detail: Malformed, duplicate or empty expert output returns the original T0 response.

layers.name: Strict question guard
layers.detail: Cancels the shadow question and fails closed if A ever emits other.

b.label: Fusion B
b.tagline: Fusion A plus one bounded evaluator-aligned question lifecycle
b.question_policy: Replaces the unserved specific question with bounded other; ranking is unchanged.
b.decision: Best Public score; 2k aggregate gain with measured fold/override risk

layers.name: Frozen Fusion A
layers.detail: Runs the exact A retrieval, rank expert, grace, tail, fallback and served ledger.

layers.name: Reply consumer
layers.detail: Consumes informative, exhausted or boundary replies to the previous other question.

layers.name: Override reset
layers.detail: Starts a fresh bounded question lifecycle when visible text changes intent.

layers.name: Bounded gate
layers.detail: Asks at most two times per intent version, with a bounded boundary exception; never on turn 10.

layers.name: Question swap
layers.detail: Cancels A's unserved specific question and emits ask_attribute=other.

layers.name: Unchanged Top10
layers.detail: Recommendations, rank order, two-page grace and fallback are byte-for-byte A behavior.

layers.name: Exception fallback
layers.detail: Any adapter error returns the original A response unchanged.

page1.label: Intent page 1
page1.title: Exploit the teammate's strongest first impression
page1.description: T0 and A/B all serve the teammate Top10. A/B also compute the v2.12 expert in shadow so later exploration has a causal, current-intent order.

page2.label: Intent page 2
page2.title: Use the clarification reply without destabilizing ranking
page2.description: The second intent page remains exact T0. B may change only the question field and message; its Top10 is still A/T0 identity.

page3.label: Intent page 3+
page3.title: Switch from exploitation to unseen exploration
page3.description: A/B read the current v2.12 final order, exclude every served ID, take up to 10 unseen products, then fill safely from T0. T0 continues its own unseen ProductScorer pagination.

override.label: Intent override
override.title: Reset the page and question lifecycle around the new intent
override.description: Visible override text clears A's page/served ledger and B's bounded-other lifecycle. The new intent again receives two exact T0 pages before exploration.

official_boundary.agent_contract: reset(session_id, user_profile) and respond(session_id, user_message, turn, top_k)
official_boundary.catalog: Frozen 50,000 products; only valid unique parent_asin values can be scored.
official_boundary.turns: At most 10 turns; evaluator scores the first 10 valid unique recommendations.
official_boundary.runtime: Offline and deterministic; target IDs, labels, scenario and evaluator state are not runtime features.
official_boundary.website: Local demonstration and post-hoc diagnostics only. It is not imported by the official Agent and does not modify evaluator or data files.
